name: auto-dev
description: Drive a single coding task from ticket to merged pull request autonomously — define, plan, build, verify, and ship — using a purpose-built worker (subagent) per delegated job, handing back any task too big for one PR. Stack-agnostic: it researches each repo's setup and quality gate, confirms them with you and can save them for later runs, with optional Jira/CI/staging integration and human gates before PR and merges.
